notes: PlaylistInfos C2 constructor: flag, words 0 and 1 of the record (names not identified), zero indices and group/element tables
PlaylistInfos C1 constructor: same body as C2
NativePlaylist::GetState copies the indices, repeat words and the group vector pointer into PlaylistState; the original returns this in r0, dropped
GetPlaylistElement(): returns 0 when the remaining-repeats word is zero; the group walk needs SegmentGroup virtuals at slots +0x08 and +0x10 (not ported), so the non-zero path is missing
PeekAtNextElement(): returns 0 when the remaining-repeats word is zero; the walk needs SegmentGroup slot +0x0c (PeekAtNextGroupElement) which is not a virtual in the port, so the rest is missing
Reset(): the state words are reset; the per-group virtual at slot +0x10 with argument 0 is not ported and is missing
SetState(NativePlaylist&): copies the nine scalar words; the per-group GetSelectMode and slot +0x14 SetState calls are not ported and are missing
SetToPreviousState(): restores the previous group, element and repeats; the group virtual at slot +0x18 is not ported and is missing
GetPlaylistElement(int,int,int) dispatch is complete; mode 0 calls NativePlaylist::GetPlaylistElement() which is partial
SetState(NativePlaylistsManager&): copies flag and field_04, then calls NativePlaylist::SetState per playlist, which is partial

AddPlaylist: builds the playlist in place (placement new into VoxAlloc storage) and counts it; a failed allocation clears the flag. Original constructs into a null block when allocation fails; the port skips that
NativePlaylist D1 destructor: destroys and frees each group (virtual destructor, VoxFree). The element table at +0x30 is not freed (owner and element type not identified in the port)
NativePlaylistsManager D1 destructor: destroys and frees each playlist, then the pointer array; depends on the partial NativePlaylist destructor
NativePlaylistsManager D2 destructor: same body as D1; depends on the partial NativePlaylist destructor
NativePlaylist D2 destructor: same body as D1 (see 0x8825b8 for the missing element table free)
SetState(PlaylistState*): copies the six state words; the per-group loop (GetState and SetState group virtuals at slots +0x1c and +0x24) is not ported and is missing
TransposePlaylistParameters: GetState from one playlist and SetState into the other; the SetState(PlaylistState*) it calls is partial

NativePlaylist::AddPlaylistElement: sequential branch and group validity done; the element record (0x14 bytes into the +0x30 vector) and the random branch (RandomGroup::AddElement needs RandomGroupElement*, record not identified) are missing
NativePlaylistsManager::AddPlaylistElement: forwards to playlist words_[0] and takes its validity; depends on the partial NativePlaylist::AddPlaylistElement
NativePlaylist::AddGroup: sequential branch builds a SequentialGroup (reset flag from +0x04); the random branch (RandomGroup needs a GroupInfos constructor, not ported) adds nothing
NativePlaylistsManager::AddGroup: forwards to playlist at GroupInfos word 0 and takes its validity; depends on the partial NativePlaylist::AddGroup
NativePlaylist C1 copy constructor: scalar words copied; group and element copies are not ported (SegmentGroup copy constructors and the element table)
NativePlaylistsManager C1 copy constructor: allocates the pointer array and copies each playlist; depends on the partial NativePlaylist copy constructor
NativePlaylistsManager C2 copy constructor: same body as C1; depends on the partial NativePlaylist copy constructor
NativePlaylist C2 copy constructor: same body as C1; group and element copies missing
